project_name: Sanjeevani Care - Rural Healthcare AI Referral Platform

core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Combine botanical warmth (healing sage, earthy sand) with high-density emergency tactical status dashboards
Emotion First: Evoke trust, immediate clarity, and calmness during medical distress
Content is King: Highlight referral lifecycles (Pending → Accepted → In Transit → Arrived → Completed) with clear live status indicators
High Density & Zero Friction: Direct actions for ASHA workers, Hospitals, and Patients without overwhelming menus
Tactical High Visibility: Contrast-driven typography with strict APCA contrast compliance for low-light rural smartphone screens

typography.heading_font: Cabinet Grotesk, Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif
typography.body_font: IBM Plex Sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.caption: text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous padding: p-4 to p-8 inside bordered cards, gap-6 to gap-8 in grids
layout_and_spacing.header: Glassmorphism navigation bar (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/85 dark:bg-emerald-950/80 border-b border-emerald-900/10 z-50 sticky top-0)

components_and_ui.shadcn_customizations: Customized rounded-xl or rounded-2xl radii, soft inner borders, high-contrast badges, non-transparent popovers and dropdowns
mandatory_controls: Role Switcher / Role Auth Tabs (Patient, ASHA Worker, Hospital Admin)
Smart Matching AI Bar with Symptom & Emergency Triage Selector
Live Referral Status Tracker Stepper (Pending → Accepted → In Transit → Arrived → Completed)
Real-time Hospital Bed & ICU Availability Counters (Total vs Available)
Patient Medical Report File Upload & View Box
Distance & Rank Score Matrix for Matched Hospitals

testing_requirements.data_testid_policy: Mandatory data-testid on all key interactive elements and state displays

instructions_to_main_agent: Do not build a generic landing page only. The application must feature fully interactive, multi-role views for Patients, ASHA Workers, and Hospital Admins.
Implement the FastAPI backend endpoints seamlessly or connect frontend state with robust mock fallback if backend services are offline.
Ensure the Smart AI Hospital Matching algorithm ranks by: Specialty Match + Bed Availability + Distance (KM).
Referral state machine MUST strictly follow: Pending -> Accepted -> In Transit -> Arrived -> Completed (with optional Rejected branch).
Use Toast notifications via Sonner on every state transition (Referral accepted, Ambulance dispatched, Bed count updated).
Every dropdown, popover, modal, and header MUST have solid high-contrast backgrounds (no pure transparent drop-downs).
All components use JS/JSX syntax as configured in the frontend repository.
